detail.title: 2MP 25× Starlight IR Positioning System
detail.overview: Compare Favourite PTZ1A225-HNR-GB 2MP 25× Starlight IR Positioning System Key Points • High-Quality Imaging with 2MP Resolution • 25× Optical Zoom Provide Close Up Views Over Expansive Areas • Expansive Night View With up to 150 m IR Distance for 24/7 Monitoring • Face Detection：Leveraging Facial Data to Enhance Analytics Accuracy • Video Metadata: Multi-Target Detection and Analysis with Real-Time Tracking • Auto Tracking 3.0：Effective Target Monitoring with Detailed Intruder Trajectories • Enhanced Deep Learning-Based Human and Vehicle Classification • IP67 for Protection Against Harsh Environments Sales Enquiry Datasheet

General.Min. Illumination: Color: 0.005 lux@F1.6 B/W: 0.0005 lux@F1.6 0 lux (IR light on)
General.Pan/Tilt Range: Pan: 0° to 360° endless Tilt: –90° to +90°, auto flip 180°
General.Video Metadata: Motor vehicle, non-motor vehicle, face, and human body detection; optimization; capturing pictures; uploading high-quality snapshots; extracting 12 attributes from vehicles
General.IVS (Perimeter Protection): Tripwire; intrusion; crossing fence detection; loitering detection; abandoned/missing object; fast moving; parking detection; people gathering; vehicle/human alarm classification; linkage tracking
General.Face Detection: Supports face detection, face bounding box, optimization, capturing snapshots, enhancing face images, and uploading high-quality face snapshots, and extracts 6 attributes and 8 expressions from face images. Face cutout is also offered, where you can cutout one face at a time and customize the size to be a one-inch photo. The supported methods for capturing snapshots are real-time capturing, optimization and quality first
General.People Counting: Supports tripwire for people counting at entrances and exits, counting the number of people staying in an area and queuing in an area, and displaying and exporting reports based on the day, week and month
General.Acupick: Uses deep learning algorithms and works with back-end devices to accurately match targets, such as people and motor vehicles, and search through live and recorded videos to quickly locate targets
General.Auto Patrol: It triggers the IVS rule when a target is detected and makes the camera link with the PTZ to rotate to the position of the target and patrol based on its presets
General.Video Compression: H.264H; H.264B; Smart H.265+; H.264; H.265; Smart H.264+; MJPEG (Sub Stream)
General.Video Frame Rate: Main stream: 1080p/1.3M/720p@(1-50/60 fps) Sub stream 1: D1/VGA/CIF@(1-25/30 fps) Sub stream 2: 1080p/1.3M/720p@(1-25/30 fps)
General.Video Bit Rate: H.264: 64 kbps–10496 kbps H.265: 25 kbps–6400 kbps
General.White Balance: Auto; indoor; outdoor; tracking; manual; sodium lamp; natural light; street lamp
General.Privacy Masking: Up to 24 areas can be set, with up to 8 areas in the same view; multiple colors available
General.Storage: FTP/SFTP; Micro SD card (512 GB); NAS
General.Browser: IE 9 and later versions Chrome 41 and later versions Firefox 50 and later versions Safari 10 and later versions
General.Alarm Linkage: Capture; preset; pattern; tour; recording; send email; alarm digital input
General.Alarm Event: Motion/tampering detection; audio detection; network disconnection detection; IP conflict detection; memory card state detection; memory space detection
General.Protection: IP67, TVS 6000 V lightning proof; surge protection; voltage transient protection
General.Casing Material: Die cast aluminum: ADC12, spray finishing
